en:
Hey, what are you doing?
Everyone else is in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't remember there being any
mysterious objects here. I'll look elsewhere.
<CLT=cltMIND>For now, I'll head to the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito is probably in the dining hall.
I should hurry and meet him there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito said he was waiting in the courtyard...
But where exactly?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to get some breakfast first...
I should go to the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>The magic show was going to be in the
gym, right? I should go watch.

What's the matter?
This isn't related to the case, right?

We don't know when the class trial's gonna 
start. We can't just be going on a walk.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should head to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Shrine of Judgment<CLT=cltMIND>
in the courtyard...

Don't worry! You can do it.
I believe in you!
Now, let's go to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Shrine of Judgment<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
